lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular pixel clusters (~15-25 pixels in diameter) arranged in approximately vertical columns posterior to the fifth gill slit, forming a semi-regular grid pattern across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the primary circular maculae, creating grid-like anchor nodes characteristic of the species' lateral patterning.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible running along the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient with higher pixel values on the dorsal edge and a shadow transition on the ventral edge.
